questions.passage: The baby boom resulted from a decrease in the public's inherent taste for children. This argument about birth rates is highly __________ (problem) for economists.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: problem → problematic: be동사 뒤 보어 자리에 형용사가 필요하므로 명사 problem을 형용사형 problematic으로 변환
det.analysis: 정답: problematic (problem의 형용사형)

questions.passage: To an economist who succeeds in figuring out a person's preference structure—understanding whether the satisfaction gained from consuming one good is greater than that of another—explaining behavior in terms of changes in underlying likes and dislikes is usually highly problematic. To argue, for instance, that the baby boom and then the baby bust resulted from an increase and then a decrease in the public's inherent taste for children, rather than a change in relative prices against a background of stable preferences, places a social scientist in an unsound position. In economics, such an argument about birth rates would be equivalent to saying that a rise and fall in mortality could be attributed to an increase in the inherent desire change for death. For an economist, changes in income and prices, rather than changes in tastes, affect birth rates. When income rises, for example, people want more children (or, as you will see later, more satisfaction derived from children), even if their inherent desire for children __________ the same.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: stays(유지된다) — 소득이 올라도 선천적 욕구가 동일하게 유지된다는 문맥
det.analysis:
✅ ① stays: 유지된다 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② changes: 변한다 — 문맥 반대
❌ ③ increases: 증가한다 — 문맥 반대
❌ ④ decreases: 감소한다 — 문맥 반대

det.korean: 빈칸: attributed(기인하는) — 사망률의 증감이 죽음 욕구의 증가에 기인할 수 있다는 문맥(could be attributed to)
